Fact: data_provenance
What to find: Provenance categories of training data (web crawl, licensed/third-party private, user data, public datasets, synthetic, other).
Card sections that often contain it: Training Data, Data Sources

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: The card names only datasets, not provenance categories: pre-trained on the Dolma 3 dataset and post-trained on the Dolci datasets. The SFT, DPO and RLVR datasets consist of math, code, chat, and general knowledge queries (RLVR: math, code, instruction-following, and general chat queries).
quotes: These models are pre-trained on the Dolma 3 dataset and post-trained on the Dolci datasets.
- supervised fine-tuning on the Dolci-Think-SFT-7B dataset. This dataset consits of math, code, chat, and general knowledge queries.
- reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards on the Dolci-Think-RL-7B dataset. This dataset consits of math, code, instruction-following, and general chat queries.
